description: Downstream-application compatibility request. This file specifies what the downstream inference program can consume; it is not one of the generated context/user-study cases.

request_identity.application_name: CHiME-Home Domestic Sound Event Inference App
request_identity.natural_language_request: Provide audio waveform chunks that the CHiME-Home audio tagging pipeline can consume.

source_requirements.notes: The downstream program expects audio waveform chunks. Semantic sound labels, decibel levels, transcripts, or command intents are not accepted as preprocessing outputs for this app request.

utility_contract.task_description: Run the downstream CHiME-Home audio tagging model over waveform chunks and emit sound-event labels.

accepted_output_caps.utility_notes: Compatible with infer_home_audio.py because ChimeHomeDataset loads audio chunks and the model computes waveform/logmel/AST features.
Potentially compatible if the filtered waveform can still be loaded as audio and event-tagging utility is validated.

payload_requirements.sample_rate: preserve or resample to downstream expected rate

explicitly_rejected_output_caps.reason: The CHiME-Home inference program emits sound-event labels; it does not consume labels as input.
Decibel level is insufficient for the attached audio tagging model.
Transcripts are not waveform chunks for CHiME-Home audio tagging.
Command intents are not valid inputs for the audio-event tagging model.

downstream_program.name: infer_home_audio.py
downstream_program.input_kind: manifest loaded by ChimeHomeDataset into waveform or AST features
downstream_program.model_role: The downstream program classifies sound/event labels from audio chunks.

compatibility_notes: Speech-content removal is only compatible if the output remains a loadable audio waveform and the event-tagging accuracy is validated.

compatibility_constraints.accepted_schema_match: candidate output caps must match at least one accepted_output_caps entry
compatibility_constraints.required_capability_match: candidate utility_capabilities must include requested_capability or a declared equivalent
adapter_rules: Adapters may repackage data into the manifest/sample schema required by the downstream program only when the underlying payload type remains compatible.
A privacy-minimized semantic label is not utility-compatible unless the downstream program explicitly accepts that semantic label as input.

residual_disclosure_constraints.comparison_rule: candidate residual disclosure vector must be <= max_allowed for every attribute, except attributes listed in allowed_high_attributes

no_compromise_conditions: Return no_compromise if no candidate pipeline both matches an accepted output cap and satisfies CI/residual-disclosure constraints.
Return insufficient_utility_evidence if the output cap/schema is accepted but no benchmark, calibration, or app-provided validation exists.
Do not select a semantic/privacy-minimized output solely because it is acceptable under CI if the downstream inference program cannot consume it.
